aiAgents.question: What's an AI Agent and how can it help my business?
aiAgents.answer: An AI Agent is a software program powered by Artificial Intelligence that can autonomously handle tasks, make decisions and learn from data or user interactions to achieve a human-like performance. By automating repetitive processes and providing real-time insights, AI Agents help any kind of business save time, cut costs, reduce error, and boost overall efficiency.

implementation.question: What's the difference between an Automation and an AI Agent?
implementation.answer: AI automation refers to the use of artificial intelligence to automate specific tasks and processes, such as data classification or report generation. On the other hand, an AI agent is a system that can interact with its environment, make decisions, and take actions autonomously, such as a virtual assistant or a robot.

security.question: What's the typical ROI for an AI Automation/Agent implementation?
security.answer: While results vary by industry and project scope, many businesses report a substantial return on investment -sometimes exceeding 200% in the first year- after automating key processes or enhancing customer interactions with AI Agents.

customization.question: How long does it takes to deliver my Automations or AI Agents?
customization.answer: Delivery timelines vary based on the complexity of the agent/automation required, our average times are 1-2 week/agent for development and 1-2 week/agent for deployment. Upon receiving your project requirements, we'll provide an estimated timeline and keep you updated on our progress.

integration.question: What's included when paying for your monthly subscription?
integration.answer: A full team and everything you need to automate your business with AI, including AI Agents development and deployment, custom model training and fine-tuning, data processing and vectorization, AI automations and more. Each service is customized to integrate seamlessly into your current business processes.

support.question: What if I don't know what AI Agents I need?
support.answer: That's exactly what we are here for. Our AI consultation process is designed to uncover the most beneficial AI applications for your business. By examining your current operations, challenges, and goals, we identify key areas where AI can deliver the greatest impact.

pricing.question: Is there a limit on how many AI Agents I can request?
pricing.answer: While there's no cap on the number of agents you can request, we focus on delivering them sequentially 1 at a time to ensure each solution meets our quality standards and aligns with your business objectives.

singleAgent.question: Can I have one single AI Automation/Agent request?
singleAgent.answer: Our flexible service model allows you to get a quotation for exactly what' needed. Whether you start with a single agent or plan to scale, we accommodate your evolving AI strategy and requirements.

dataPrivacy.question: How do you ensure data security?
dataPrivacy.answer: For clients concerned with data privacy, we offer solutions using Azure OpenAI, ensuring that your data remains confidential and isn't even shared with OpenAI itself.

techStack.question: What Technology Stack do you use?
techStack.answer: Our agents are developed using mainly N8N.io frameworks and OpenAI Assistants API. We deploy our agents using either our own hosting and environments, or we can also deploy them on any of your own infrastructure.

underperforming.question: What if my AI Agents are underperforming?
underperforming.answer: Should any agent fall short of expectations after the implementation deadline, we're committed to refining its performance **at no cost**. We'll iterate on the solution until it perfomrs at the level promised/agreed on the requirements for the proyect.

moneyBack.question: Do you have a Money Back Guarantee?
moneyBack.answer: Yes, if you are not satisfied with our service after 1 week. You can get a 75% refund.
